in_hebrew.name: לינא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word לנה (lana) meaning 'to weave', this name suggests one who is delicate and tender, like a finely woven fabric.

in_greek.name: Λάινα
in_greek.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Greek word λεία (leia) meaning 'pure, clear'. It may also be associated with the goddess Leto, whose name is derived from the same root.

in_latin.name: Laina
